question: We define the dual of a line \(y=mx+c\) to be the point \((m,-c)\). Consider a set of \(n\)-non-vertical lines, \(n>3\), passing through the point \((1,1)\). Then the duals of these lines will always

options.D: form the vertices of a polygon with positive area.
